summary.oneLiner: KDDL delivered strong 32.5% H1FY26 revenue growth driven by Precision Engineering (44% YoY) and Packaging (70% YoY), while watch components faced global headwinds but are stabilizing; the company's vertical integration and capacity expansion in electroplating and bracelets position it to capture higher-margin opportunities as global watch demand normalizes.

one-line thesis: KDDL delivered strong 32.5% H1FY26 revenue growth driven by Precision Engineering (44% YoY) and Packaging (70% YoY), while watch components faced global headwinds but are stabilizing; the company's vertical integration and capacity expansion in electroplating and bracelets position it to capture higher-margin opportunities as global watch demand normalizes.
financial scorecard: revenue: +32.5% YoY (H1FY26); EBITDA/margin: +20.5% YoY, 22.5% H1 margin; PAT (rptd): +20.5% YoY, 10.9% margin; PAT (normalized): no material one-offs; order book: not disclosed; net debt: not disclosed
guidance: revenue growth: 20-25% long-term for Precision Engineering; margin: stable EBITDA margin target ~20-22%; order inflow: steady export demand; capex/commissioning: INR15-18cr in H2FY26, electroplating facility by Q1FY27
segment / subsidiary detail: Watch Components: INR115cr H1FY26, 10% YoY export growth to India, China/HK down; Precision Engineering: INR90cr H1FY26, 44% YoY growth, 40% exposure to alternate energy (incl. EV); Packaging: INR70% YoY growth on small base; Bracelets: >80% capacity utilization, profitable, expanding with flexible tech; Favre-Leuba: sales exceeding budget, U.S. tariff reduced to 15%, global expansion ongoing
growth verticals / optionality: Export diversification beyond Switzerland (Europe, Asia); packaging export potential to global luxury brands; electroplating in-house capacity enabling higher-value orders; Favre-Leuba brand scaling to 8,000+ watches/year by CY2026
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin for Precision Engineering ~20%; watch component margins pressured by mix shift and front-ended costs in new bracelet/packaging units; no material input cost inflation cited; cost rationalization ongoing
capex / expansion: INR9cr spent in H1FY26; INR15-18cr expected in H2FY26; focus on electroplating facility (Q1FY27 commissioning), bracelet unit expansion, and incremental space for Eigen
capital allocation: Interim dividend: INR15/share declared; capex prioritized for capacity expansion; no M&A announced beyond Favre-Leuba; no share buybacks mentioned
risks & watch-items: U.S. tariffs on Swiss watches (now reduced to 15%); China/HK luxury demand slowdown; currency volatility; global watch industry cyclicality; execution risk in new capacity ramp-up
management quality / tone: Confident and proactive; emphasized long-term growth targets, vertical integration, and resilience to short-term tariffs; highlighted execution discipline and flexibility in manufacturing; optimistic on Favre-Leuba and Precision Engineering momentum
non-obvious takeaways: KDDL's natural forex hedge between export-heavy KDDL and import-heavy Ethos subsidiary; precision stamping for connectors is a hidden high-margin niche supplying Amphenol/TE Connectivity; bracelet expansion uses flexible tech for small-batch production, aligning with luxury industry's shift to agility

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "Over 40 years of excellence in watch components and precision manufacturing" and "Among the largest independent dial and hand manufacturers serving global luxury brands"; within Taratec, dials are described as "One of the largest independent manufacturers of high-quality watch dials in India and Switzerland".
- Global footprint: "Operations across India and Switzerland, serving top International brands" with "Exports contribute significantly to revenue, supported by long-standing OEM partnerships"; brand name TARATEC was adopted for export in 1998.
- Diversified business portfolio across three arms — Watch Components (Dials, Hands, Indexes and Bracelets); Ornamental Packaging (Ornapac): luxury boxes for Watches & Jewellery; and Precision Engineering (Eigen): high-precision components for auto, aerospace, industrials and alternate energy.
- Eigen is a "Certified leader in precision metal stamping and tool & die manufacturing", certified to IATF 16949, ISO 9001 and AS 9100D and described as a "preferred global supplier" with "Diversified industry exposure across high-margin, export-driven markets".
- Ornapac is a "Leading manufacturer of premium watch, jewelry, and gifting boxes" serving "top global luxury and lifestyle brands", with "Strong synergy with KDDL's dial & bracelet businesses in luxury value chain".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition/Brand] In 2023 KDDL acquired the iconic Swiss brand Favre-Leuba, with plans for a global relaunch; it is housed in Silvercity Brands AG (93.08%, directly and indirectly through subsidiaries), described as "Business of premium luxury watches under the brand 'Favre Leuba'".
- [Group vs listed entity] Consolidated figures are dominated by the retail subsidiary rather than the components business: FY26 consolidated revenue from operations is Rs 2,153.4 Cr against standalone Rs 495.8 Cr, and FY26 consolidated gross profit margin is 42.2% against standalone 74.9% — the two bases must not be read interchangeably.
- [Regulation] The FY26 consolidated P&L carries an Exceptional Expense of Rs 2.4 Cr, footnoted as "Statutory impact of Labor Codes of Rs. 2.45 Cr" (the deck states 2.4 in the table and 2.45 in the footnote).
- [Historical one-offs] FY24 standalone included an Exceptional Expense of Rs 19.6 Cr, footnoted as an "impairment allowance in the value of investment which is accounted for in other expenses"; FY23 standalone included an Exceptional Expense of Rs 19.0 Cr, footnoted as a "One-time value creation award to Mr. Yashovardhan Saboo (Chairman & MD)". These make the FY23/FY24 standalone PAT and EPS non-comparable with other years.
- [Investor relations] The deck names Sanjeev Masown as CFO of KDDL and Strategic Growth Advisors Limited as the investor-relations advisor.
